2784 void
2785 update_transformation (coord_t *v)
2786 {
2787 if (optimize_coordinates == 1)
2788 {
2789 point_t center = tiles[0].pos[(twidth / 2) * twidth + theight / 2];
2790 /* First move center to 0. */
2791 matrix3x3 trans = translation_3x3matrix (center * -1);
2792 /* Next apply scale */
2793 trans = scale_3x3matrix (get_scale (v)) * trans;
2794 /* Next apply offset. */
2795 trans = translation_3x3matrix (get_offset (v, 0)) * trans;
2796 /* Next apply rotation. */
2797 trans = rotation_3x3matrix (get_rotation (v)) * trans;
2798 /* Now translate back. */
2799 trans = translation_3x3matrix (center) * trans;
2800 transformation = trans;
2801 }
2802 else if (optimize_coordinates == 2)
2803 {
2804 point_t center = {(coord_t)(-theight/2), (coord_t)(-twidth/2)};
2805 /* First move center to 0. */
2806 matrix3x3 trans = translation_3x3matrix (center);
2807 /* Next apply scale */
2808 trans = scale_3x3matrix (get_scale (v)) * trans;
2809 /* Next apply offset. */
2810 trans = translation_3x3matrix (get_offset (v, 0)) * trans;
2811 /* Next apply rotation. */
2812 trans = rotation_3x3matrix (get_rotation (v)) * trans;
2813 transformation = trans;
2814 //printf ("offet %f %f, rotation %f, scale %f %f tl %f %f; tr %f %f; bl %f %f; br%f %f centr %f %f\n", get_offset (v, 0).x, get_offset (v, 0).y, get_rotation (v), get_scale (v), (get_pos (v, 0, {0, 0}) - get_pos (v, 0, {0,1})).length (), get_pos (v,0,{0,0}).x, get_pos (v,0,{0,0}).y, get_pos (v,0,{twidth,0}).x, get_pos (v,0,{twidth,0}).y, get_pos (v,0,{0,theight}).x, get_pos (v,0,{0,theight}).y,get_pos (v,0,{twidth,theight}).x, get_pos (v,0,{twidth,theight}).y,get_pos (v,0,{twidth/2,theight/2}).x, get_pos (v,0,{twidth/2,theight/2}).y);
2815 }
2816 }
2817
2818 /* Objective function to minimize difference between simulated and actual
2819 scan. V is vector of parameters. */
2820 coord_t
2821 objfunc (coord_t *v)
2822 {
2823 /* Use double to avoid accumulation of round-off error. */
2824 double sum = 0;
2825 update_transformation (v);
2826 for (int tileid = 0; tileid < n_tiles; tileid++)
2827 {
2828 /* FIXME: parallelism is disabled because sometimes we are called from
2829 * parallel block. */
2830 if (tiles[tileid].sharpened_color
2831 && tiles[tileid].sharpened_color != tiles[tileid].color.data ())
2832 sharpen<rgbdata, rgbdata, rgbdata *, int, getdata_helper> (
2833 tiles[tileid].sharpened_color, tiles[tileid].color.data (), theight,
2834 twidth, theight, get_sharpen_radius (v), get_sharpen_amount (v),
2835 nullptr, false);
2836 bool updated = init_screen (v, tileid);
2837 simulate_screen (v, tileid, updated);
2838 }
2839 double_rgbdata red, green, blue;
2840 rgbdata color;
2841 if (!tiles[0].color.empty ())
2842 get_colors (v, &red, &green, &blue);
2843 else
2844 color = bw_get_color (v);
2845 rgbdata mix_weights;
2846 luminosity_t mix_dark = 0;
2847 if (simulate_infrared)
2848 {
2849 mix_weights = get_mix_weights (v);
2850 mix_dark = get_mix_dark (v);
2851 }
2852 for (int tileid = 0; tileid < n_tiles; tileid++)
2853 {
2854 if (!tiles[0].color.empty ())
2855 {
2856 for (int y = border; y < theight - border; y++)
2857 for (int x = border; x < twidth - border; x++)
2858 if (!noutliers || !tiles[tileid].outliers->test_bit (x, y))
2859 {
2860 rgbdata c = evaluate_pixel (v, tileid, red, green, blue, x,
2861 y, mix_weights, mix_dark);
2862 rgbdata d = get_pixel (v, tileid, { x, y });
2863
2864 /* Bayer pattern.
2865 TODO: This weighting is specific to Bayer patterns; for
2866 general screen plates, a more uniform weighting should
2867 be used. We will address this later. */
2868 if (!(x & 1) && !(y & 1))
2869 sum += my_fabs (c.red - d.red) * 2;
2870 else if ((x & 1) && (y & 1))
2871 sum += my_fabs (c.blue - d.blue) * 2;
2872 else
2873 sum += my_fabs (c.green - d.green);
2874#if 0
2875 sum += my_fabs (c.red - d.red) + my_fabs (c.green - d.green) + my_fabs (c.blue - d.blue);
2876#endif
2877 /*(c.red - d.red) * (c.red - d.red) + (c.green - d.green) *
2878 * (c.green - d.green) + (c.blue - d.blue) * (c.blue -
2879 * d.blue)*/
2880 }
2881 }
2882 else if (!tiles[tileid].bw.empty ())
2883 {
2884 for (int y = border; y < theight - border; y++)
2885 for (int x = border; x < twidth - border; x++)
2886 if (!noutliers || !tiles[tileid].outliers->test_bit (x, y))
2887 {
2888 luminosity_t c
2889 = bw_evaluate_pixel (tileid, color, x, y);
2890 luminosity_t d = bw_get_pixel (tileid, { x, y });
2891 sum += my_fabs (c - d);
2892 }
2893 sum /= maxgray;
2894 }
2895 }
2896 // printf ("%f\n", sum);
2897 /* Avoid solver from increasing blur past point it is no longer useful.
2898 Otherwise it will pick solutions with too large blur and very contrasty
2899 colors. */
2900 //compute_contrast ();
2901 return (sum / sample_points ())
2902 * ((coord_t)1
2903 + get_blur_radius (v)
2904 * (coord_t)0.01) /*/ std::max (contrast, (luminosity_t)0.0000001)*/; ;
2905 }
2906
2907 void
2908 collect_screen (screen *s, coord_t *v, int tileid)
2909 {
2910 for (int y = 0; y < screen::size; y++)
2911 for (int x = 0; x < screen::size; x++)
2912 for (int c = 0; c < 3; c++)
2913 {
2914 s->mult[y][x][c] = (luminosity_t)0;
2915 s->add[y][x][c] = (luminosity_t)0;
2916 }
2917 for (int y = border; y < theight - border; y++)
2918 for (int x = border; x < twidth - border; x++)
2919 if (!noutliers || !tiles[tileid].outliers->test_bit (x, y))
2920 {
2921 point_t p = get_pos (v, tileid, {x, y});
2922 int xx = ((int64_t)nearest_int (p.x * screen::size))
2923 & (screen::size - 1);
2924 int yy = ((int64_t)nearest_int (p.y * screen::size))
2925 & (screen::size - 1);
2926 if (!tiles[tileid].color.empty ())
2927 {
2928 s->mult[yy][xx][0]
2929 = tiles[tileid].sharpened_color[y * twidth + x].red;
2930 s->mult[yy][xx][1]
2931 = tiles[tileid].sharpened_color[y * twidth + x].green;
2932 s->mult[yy][xx][2]
2933 = tiles[tileid].sharpened_color[y * twidth + x].blue;
2934 }
2935 else
2936 {
2937 s->mult[yy][xx][0] = tiles[tileid].bw[y * twidth + x];
2938 s->mult[yy][xx][1] = tiles[tileid].bw[y * twidth + x];
2939 s->mult[yy][xx][2] = tiles[tileid].bw[y * twidth + x];
2940 }
2941 s->add[yy][xx][0] = 1;
2942 }
2943 for (int i = 0; i < screen::size; i++)
2944 for (int y = 0; y < screen::size; y++)
2945 for (int x = 0; x < screen::size; x++)
2946 if (!s->add[y][x][0])
2947 {
2948 luminosity_t newv[3]
2949 = { (luminosity_t)0, (luminosity_t)0, (luminosity_t)0 };
2950 int n = 0;
2951 for (int xo = -1; xo <= 1; xo++)
2952 for (int yo = -1; yo <= 1; yo++)
2953 {
2954 int nx = (x + xo) & (screen::size - 1);
2955 int ny = (y + yo) & (screen::size - 1);
2956 if (s->mult[ny][nx][0] + s->mult[ny][nx][1]
2957 + s->mult[ny][nx][2])
2958 {
2959 newv[0] += s->mult[ny][nx][0];
2960 newv[1] += s->mult[ny][nx][1];
2961 newv[2] += s->mult[ny][nx][2];
2962 n++;
2963 }
2964 }
2965 if (n)
2966 {
2967 s->mult[y][x][0] = newv[0] / n;
2968 s->mult[y][x][1] = newv[1] / n;
2969 s->mult[y][x][2] = newv[2] / n;
2970 }
2971 }
2972 for (int y = 0; y < screen::size; y++)
2973 for (int x = 0; x < screen::size; x++)
2974 s->add[y][x][0] = 0;
2975 }

2977 int
2978 determine_outliers (coord_t *v, coord_t ratio)
2979 {
2980 double_rgbdata red, green, blue;
2981 get_colors (v, &red, &green, &blue);
2982 rgbdata mix_weights = { 0, 0, 0 };
2983 luminosity_t mix_dark = 0;
2984
2985 if (simulate_infrared)
2986 {
2987 mix_weights = get_mix_weights (v);
2988 mix_dark = get_mix_dark (v);
2989 }
2990 for (int tileid = 0; tileid < n_tiles; tileid++)
2991 {
2992 histogram hist;
2993 for (int y = border; y < theight - border; y++)
2994 for (int x = border; x < twidth - border; x++)
2995 {
2996 rgbdata c = evaluate_pixel (v, tileid, red, green, blue, x, y,
2997 mix_weights, mix_dark);
2998 rgbdata d = get_pixel (v, tileid, { x, y });
2999 coord_t err = my_fabs (c.red - d.red) + my_fabs (c.green - d.green)
3000 + my_fabs (c.blue - d.blue);
3001 hist.pre_account (err);
3002 }
3003 hist.finalize_range (65535);
3004 for (int y = border; y < theight - border; y++)
3005 for (int x = border; x < twidth - border; x++)
3006 {
3007 rgbdata c = evaluate_pixel (v, tileid, red, green, blue, x, y,
3008 mix_weights, mix_dark);
3009 rgbdata d = get_pixel (v, tileid, { x, y });
3010 coord_t err = my_fabs (c.red - d.red) + my_fabs (c.green - d.green)
3011 + my_fabs (c.blue - d.blue);
3012 hist.account (err);
3013 }
3014 hist.finalize ();
3015 coord_t merr = hist.find_max (ratio) * (coord_t)1.3;
3016 tiles[tileid].outliers = std::make_shared<bitmap_2d> (twidth, theight);
3017 for (int y = border; y < theight - border; y++)
3018 for (int x = border; x < twidth - border; x++)
3019 {
3020 rgbdata c = evaluate_pixel (v, tileid, red, green, blue, x, y,
3021 mix_weights, mix_dark);
3022 rgbdata d = get_pixel (v, tileid, { x, y });
3023 coord_t err = my_fabs (c.red - d.red) + my_fabs (c.green - d.green)
3024 + my_fabs (c.blue - d.blue);
3025 if (err > merr)
3026 {
3027 noutliers++;
3028 tiles[tileid].outliers->set_bit (x, y);
3029 }
3030 }
3031 }
3032 if (!noutliers)
3033 return 0;
3034 if (least_squares)
3035 {
3036 free_least_squares ();
3037 alloc_least_squares ();
3038 if (!optimize_fog || fog_by_least_squares)
3039 init_least_squares (nullptr);
3040 }
3041 return noutliers;
3042 }

3095 std::unique_ptr<simple_image>
3096 produce_image (coord_t *v, int tileid, int type)
3097 {
3098 init_screen (v, tileid);
3099
3100 std::unique_ptr<simple_image> img = std::make_unique<simple_image> ();
3101 if (!img || !img->allocate (twidth, theight))
3102 return img;
3103
3104 if (!tiles[0].color.empty ())
3105 {
3106 luminosity_t rmax = 0, gmax = 0, bmax = 0;
3107 double_rgbdata red, green, blue;
3108 rgbdata mix_weights = { 0, 0, 0 };
3109 luminosity_t mix_dark = 0;
3110 if (simulate_infrared)
3111 {
3112 mix_weights = get_mix_weights (v);
3113 mix_dark = get_mix_dark (v);
3114 }
3115 get_colors (v, &red, &green, &blue);
3116 for (int y = 0; y < theight; y++)
3117 for (int x = 0; x < twidth; x++)
3118 {
3119 rgbdata c = evaluate_pixel (v, tileid, red, green, blue, x, y,
3120 mix_weights, mix_dark);
3121 rmax = std::max (c.red, rmax);
3122 gmax = std::max (c.green, gmax);
3123 bmax = std::max (c.blue, bmax);
3124 rgbdata d = get_pixel (v, tileid, { x, y });
3125 rmax = std::max (d.red, rmax);
3126 gmax = std::max (d.green, gmax);
3127 bmax = std::max (d.blue, bmax);
3128 }
3129
3130 for (int y = 0; y < theight; y++)
3131 {
3132 for (int x = 0; x < twidth; x++)
3133 if (type == 1 || !noutliers
3134 || !tiles[tileid].outliers->test_bit (x, y))
3135 switch (type)
3136 {
3137 case 0:
3138 {
3139 rgbdata c
3140 = evaluate_pixel (v, tileid, red, green, blue, x, y,
3141 mix_weights, mix_dark);
3142 img->put_linear_pixel (
3143 x, y,
3144 { c.red / rmax, c.green / gmax, c.blue / bmax });
3145 }
3146 break;
3147 case 1:
3148 {
3149 rgbdata d = get_orig_pixel (v, tileid, { x, y });
3150 img->put_linear_pixel (
3151 x, y,
3152 { d.red / rmax, d.green / gmax, d.blue / bmax });
3153 }
3154 break;
3155 case 2:
3156 {
3157 rgbdata c
3158 = evaluate_pixel (v, tileid, red, green, blue, x, y,
3159 mix_weights, mix_dark);
3160 rgbdata d = c - get_pixel (v, tileid, { x, y });
3161 img->put_linear_pixel (
3162 x, y,
3163 { d.red / rmax + (luminosity_t)0.5,
3164 d.green / gmax + (luminosity_t)0.5,
3165 d.blue / bmax + (luminosity_t)0.5 });
3166 }
3167 break;
3168 case 3:
3169 {
3170 rgbdata d = get_pixel (v, tileid, { x, y });
3171 img->put_linear_pixel (
3172 x, y,
3173 { d.red / rmax, d.green / gmax, d.blue / bmax });
3174 }
3175 break;
3176 }
3177 else
3178 img->put_pixel (x, y, { 0, 0, 0 });
3179 }
3180 }
3181 if (!tiles[tileid].bw.empty ())
3182 {
3183 luminosity_t lmax = 0;
3184 rgbdata color = bw_get_color (v);
3185 for (int y = 0; y < theight; y++)
3186 for (int x = 0; x < twidth; x++)
3187 {
3188 lmax = std::max (bw_evaluate_pixel (tileid, color, x, y),
3189 lmax);
3190 lmax = std::max (bw_get_pixel (tileid, { x, y }), lmax);
3191 }
3192
3193 for (int y = 0; y < theight; y++)
3194 {
3195 for (int x = 0; x < twidth; x++)
3196 if (type == 1 || !noutliers
3197 || !tiles[tileid].outliers->test_bit (x, y))
3198 switch (type)
3199 {
3200 case 0:
3201 {
3202 luminosity_t c
3203 = bw_evaluate_pixel (tileid, color, x, y)
3204 / lmax;
3205 img->put_linear_pixel (x, y, { c, c, c });
3206 }
3207 break;
3208 case 1:
3209 {
3210 luminosity_t d = bw_get_pixel (tileid, { x, y }) / lmax;
3211 img->put_linear_pixel (x, y, { d, d, d });
3212 }
3213 break;
3214 case 2:
3215 {
3216 luminosity_t c
3217 = bw_evaluate_pixel (tileid, color, x, y);
3218 luminosity_t d
3219 = (c - bw_get_pixel (tileid, { x, y })) / lmax + (luminosity_t)0.5;
3220 img->put_linear_pixel (x, y, { d, d, d });
3221 }
3222 break;
3223 }
3224 else
3225 img->put_pixel (x, y, { 0, 0, 0 });
3226 }
3227 }
3228 return img;
3229 }

3381 }
3382 }

3419 ret.coordinate2.y = (theight - 1) * dx_scr1_x / det;

3421 ret.center.y = p1_img.y - ret.coordinate1.y * p1_scr.x - ret.coordinate2.y * p1_scr.y;

3423 {

3432 point_t p3_scr_test = test_map.to_scr ({(coord_t)tiles[0].txmin, (coord_t)tiles[0].tymin + theight - 1});
3433 if (p1_scr_test.dist_from (p1_scr) > 1e-4

3436 {

3439 printf (" p2: %f %f -> %f %f (should be %f %f)\n", (coord_t)tiles[0].txmin + twidth - 1, (coord_t)tiles[0].tymin, p2_scr_test.x, p2_scr_test.y, p2_scr.x, p2_scr.y);
3440 printf (" p3: %f %f -> %f %f (should be %f %f)\n", (coord_t)tiles[0].txmin, (coord_t)tiles[0].tymin + theight - 1, p3_scr_test.x, p3_scr_test.y, p3_scr.x, p3_scr.y);
3441 printf ("Center %f %f to %f %f; Coordinates %f %f to %f %f; %f %f to %f %f\n", param.center.x, param.center.y, ret.center.x, ret.center.y, param.coordinate1.x, param.coordinate1.y, ret.coordinate1.x, ret.coordinate1.y, param.coordinate2.x, param.coordinate2.y, ret.coordinate2.x, ret.coordinate2.y);
3442 abort ();
3443 }
3444 }
3445#endif

3447 else
3448 {
3449 ret.center = param.center;

3451 ret.coordinate2 = param.coordinate2;
3452 }

3484 {
3485 ret.mix_weights = get_mix_weights (start.data ());
3486 ret.mix_dark = get_fog (start.data ());
3487 }
3488 else
3489 {
3490 ret.mix_weights.red = rparam.mix_red;
3491 ret.mix_weights.green = rparam.mix_green;
3492 ret.mix_weights.blue = rparam.mix_blue;
3493 ret.mix_dark = rparam.mix_dark;
3494 }
3495
3496 if (optimize_position && !optimize_coordinate1)
3497 {
3498 int tileid = 0;
3499 /* Construct solver point. Try to get closest point to the center of
3500 * analyzed tile. */
3501 int fsx = nearest_int (
3502 get_pos (start.data (), tileid, { twidth / 2, theight / 2 }).x);
3503 int fsy = nearest_int (
3504 get_pos (start.data (), tileid, { twidth / 2, theight / 2 }).y);
3505 int bx = -1, by = -1;
3506 coord_t bdist = 0;
3507 for (int y = 0; y < theight; y++)
3508 {
3509 for (int x = 0; x < twidth; x++)
3510 {
3511 point_t p = get_pos (start.data (), tileid, { x, y });
3512 // printf (" %-5.2f,%-5.2f", p.x, p.y);
3513 coord_t dist = my_fabs (p.x - fsx) + my_fabs (p.y - fsy);
3514 if (bx < 0 || dist < bdist)
3515 {
3516 bx = x;
3517 by = y;
3518 bdist = dist;
3519 }
3520 }
3521 // printf ("\n");
3522 }
3523 if (!bx || bx == twidth - 1 || !by || by == theight - 1)
3524 {
3525 if (verbose)
3526 {
3527 if (progress)
3528 progress->pause_stdout ();
3529 printf ("Solver point is out of tile\n");
3530 if (progress)
3531 progress->resume_stdout ();
3532 }
3533 ret.err = "Solver point is out of tile";
3534 return;
3535 }
3536 point_t fp = { -1000, -1000 };
3537
3538 bool found = false;
3539 // printf ("%i %i %i %i %f %f\n", bx, by, fsx, fsy,
3540 // tile_pos[twidth/2+(theight/2)*twidth].x,
3541 // tile_pos[twidth/2+(theight/2)*twidth].y);
3542 for (int y = by - 1; y <= by + 1; y++)
3543 for (int x = bx - 1; x <= bx + 1; x++)
3544 {
3545 /* Determine cell corners. */
3546 point_t p = { (coord_t)fsx, (coord_t)fsy };
3547 point_t p1 = get_pos (start.data (), tileid, { x, y });
3548 point_t p2 = get_pos (start.data (), tileid, { x + 1, y });
3549 point_t p3 = get_pos (start.data (), tileid, { x, y + 1 });
3550 point_t p4 = get_pos (start.data (), tileid, { x + 1, y + 1 });
3551 /* Check if point is above or below diagonal. */
3552 coord_t sgn1 = sign (p, p1, p4);
3553 if (sgn1 > 0)
3554 {
3555 /* Check if point is inside of the triangle. */
3556 if (sign (p, p4, p3) < 0 || sign (p, p3, p1) < 0)
3557 continue;
3558 coord_t rx, ry;
3559 intersect_vectors (p1.x, p1.y, p.x - p1.x, p.y - p1.y, p3.x,
3560 p3.y, p4.x - p3.x, p4.y - p3.y, &rx, &ry);
3561 rx = (coord_t)1 / rx;
3562 found = true;
3563 fp = { (ry * rx + x), (rx + y) };
3564 }
3565 else
3566 {
3567 /* Check if point is inside of the triangle. */
3568 if (sign (p, p4, p2) > 0 || sign (p, p2, p1) > 0)
3569 continue;
3570 coord_t rx, ry;
3571 intersect_vectors (p1.x, p1.y, p.x - p1.x, p.y - p1.y, p2.x,
3572 p2.y, p4.x - p2.x, p4.y - p2.y, &rx, &ry);
3573 rx = (coord_t)1 / rx;
3574 found = true;
3575 fp = { (rx + x), (ry * rx + y) };
3576 }
3577 }
3578 /* TODO: If we did not find the tile we could try some non-integer
3579 location. */
3580 if (!found)
3581 {
3582 if (verbose)
3583 {
3584 if (progress)
3585 progress->pause_stdout ();
3586 printf ("Failed to find solver point\n");
3587 if (progress)
3588 progress->resume_stdout ();
3589 }
3590 ret.err = "Failed to find solver point";
3591 return;
3592 }
3593 ret.solver_point_img_location = { fp.x + tiles[tileid].txmin + (coord_t)0.5,
3594 fp.y + tiles[tileid].tymin + (coord_t)0.5 };
3595 // printf ("New location %f %f %f %f %f %f\n", fp.x +
3596 // tiles[tileid].txmin
3597 // + 0.5, fp.y + tiles[tileid].tymin + 0.5, bx + tiles[tileid].txmin +
3598 // 0.5, by + tiles[tileid].tymin + 0.05, get_pos (start, tileid, {bx,
3599 // by}).x, get_pos (start, tileid, {bx, by}).y);
3600 ret.solver_point_screen_location.x = (coord_t)fsx;
3601 ret.solver_point_screen_location.y = (coord_t)fsy;
3602 ret.solver_point_color = solver_parameters::green;
3603 }
3604 ret.success = true;
3605 }
3606};
3607} // namespace

3609/* Produce elemnt of geometric sequence from MIN to MAX having STEPS
3610 elements of index I. */
3611static coord_t
3612geom_sequence (coord_t min, coord_t max, int steps, int i)
3613{
3614 double r = std::pow(max / min, 1.0 / steps);
3615 return min * std::pow (r, i);
3616}

3618/* Finetune parameters and update RPARAM.
3619 PARAM is scr-to-img parameters. IMG is the image data.
3620 LOCS are tile locations. RESULTS are previous results.
3621 FPARAMS are finetune parameters. PROGRESS is used to report progress. */
3622
3623finetune_result
3624finetune (const render_parameters &rparam, const scr_to_img_parameters &param,
3625 const image_data &img, const std::vector<point_t> &locs,
3626 const std::vector<finetune_result> *results,
3627 const finetune_parameters &fparams, progress_info *progress)
3628{
3629 finetune_result ret;
3630 bool tile_sharpened = false;
3631
3632 int n_tiles = locs.size ();
3633 if (fparams.flags & (finetune_coordinates | finetune_guess_coordinates))
3634 {
3635 if (n_tiles)
3636 {
3637 ret.err = "did not expect tiles";
3638 return ret;
3639 }
3640 n_tiles = 1;
3641 }
3642 else
3643 {
3644 if (n_tiles > finetune_solver::max_tiles)
3645 n_tiles = finetune_solver::max_tiles;
3646 if (!n_tiles)
3647 {
3648 ret.err = "no tile locations";
3649 return ret;
3650 }
3651 }
3652 const image_data *imgp[finetune_solver::max_tiles];
3653 scr_to_img *mapp[finetune_solver::max_tiles];
3654 int x[finetune_solver::max_tiles];
3655 int y[finetune_solver::max_tiles];
3656 coord_t pixel_size = -1;
3657
3658 scr_to_img map;
3659 imgp[0] = nullptr;
3660 mapp[0] = nullptr;
3661 x[0] = 0;
3662 y[0] = 0;
3663 for (int tileid = 0; tileid < n_tiles; tileid++)
3664 {
3665 if (fparams.flags & (finetune_coordinates | finetune_guess_coordinates))
3666 {
3667 x[tileid] = param.center.x;
3668 y[tileid] = param.center.y;
3669 }
3670 else
3671 {
3672 x[tileid] = locs[tileid].x;
3673 y[tileid] = locs[tileid].y;
3674 }
3675 imgp[tileid] = &img;
3676 if (img.stitch)
3677 {
3678 int tx, ty;
3679 point_t scr = img.stitch->common_scr_to_img.final_to_scr (
3680 { (coord_t)(x[tileid] + img.xmin),
3681 (coord_t)(y[tileid] + img.ymin) });
3682 pixel_size = img.stitch->pixel_size;
3683 if (!img.stitch->tile_for_scr (&rparam, scr.x, scr.y, &tx, &ty,
3684 true))
3685 {
3686 ret.err = "no tile for given coordinates";
3687 return ret;
3688 }
3689 point_t p = img.stitch->images[ty][tx].common_scr_to_img (scr);
3690 x[tileid] = nearest_int (p.x);
3691 y[tileid] = nearest_int (p.y);
3692 imgp[tileid] = img.stitch->images[ty][tx].img.get ();
3693 mapp[tileid] = &img.stitch->images[ty][tx].scr_to_img_map;
3694 }
3695 else
3696 {
3697 if (!tileid)
3698 {
3699 if (!map.set_parameters (param, *imgp[tileid]))
3700 {
3701 ret.err = "failed to convert screen to image coordinates";
3702 return ret;
3703 }
3704 /* TODO: determine correct pixel size area. */
3705 pixel_size
3706 = map.pixel_size ({0, 0, imgp[tileid]->width, imgp[tileid]->height});
3707 }
3708 mapp[tileid] = &map;
3709 }
3710 }
3711 bool bw = fparams.flags & finetune_bw;
3712 bool verbose = fparams.flags & finetune_verbose;
3713
3714 if (!bw && !imgp[0]->has_rgb ())
3715 bw = true;
3716
3717 int iterations = 0;
3718 int txmin, txmax, tymin, tymax;
3719 if (!(fparams.flags & finetune_guess_coordinates))
3720 {
3721 /* Determine tile to analyze. */
3722 point_t tp = mapp[0]->to_scr ({ (coord_t)x[0], (coord_t)y[0] });
3723 int sx = nearest_int (tp.x);
3724 int sy = nearest_int (tp.y);
3725
3726 coord_t def_xrange = 2;
3727 /* When not normalizing we want to avoid image in the tile. */
3728 if ((fparams.flags & finetune_no_normalize) || bw)
3729 def_xrange = 1;
3730 /* To determine rotation we need quite large context especially for Dufaycolor. */
3731 if (fparams.flags & finetune_coordinates)
3732 def_xrange = param.type == Dufay ? 8 : 5;
3733
3734 coord_t test_xrange = fparams.range ? fparams.range : def_xrange;
3735 coord_t test_yrange = test_xrange;
3736 /* If screen tile is far from rectangular, compensate.
3737 Also screen with strips has too few elements, so
3738 finetuning is not very stressed to pick reasonable solution. */
3739 if (screen_with_vertical_strips_p (param.type))
3740 test_yrange *= 3;
3741 do
3742 {
3743 if (iterations)
3744 test_xrange++, test_yrange++;
3745 point_t p = mapp[0]->to_img ({ (coord_t)sx, (coord_t)sy });
3746 coord_t sxmin = p.x, sxmax = p.x, symin = p.y, symax = p.y;
3747 p = mapp[0]->to_img ({ sx - test_xrange, sy - test_yrange });
3748 sxmin = std::min (sxmin, p.x);
3749 sxmax = std::max (sxmax, p.x);
3750 symin = std::min (symin, p.y);
3751 symax = std::max (symax, p.y);
3752 p = mapp[0]->to_img ({ sx + test_xrange, sy - test_yrange });
3753 sxmin = std::min (sxmin, p.x);
3754 sxmax = std::max (sxmax, p.x);
3755 symin = std::min (symin, p.y);
3756 symax = std::max (symax, p.y);
3757 p = mapp[0]->to_img ({ sx + test_xrange, sy + test_yrange });
3758 sxmin = std::min (sxmin, p.x);
3759 sxmax = std::max (sxmax, p.x);
3760 symin = std::min (symin, p.y);
3761 symax = std::max (symax, p.y);
3762 p = mapp[0]->to_img ({ sx - test_xrange, sy + test_yrange });
3763 sxmin = std::min (sxmin, p.x);
3764 sxmax = std::max (sxmax, p.x);
3765 symin = std::min (symin, p.y);
3766 symax = std::max (symax, p.y);
3767
3768 txmin = my_floor (sxmin);
3769 tymin = my_floor (symin);
3770 txmax = my_ceil (sxmax);
3771 tymax = my_ceil (symax);
3772 if (txmin < 0)
3773 txmin = 0;
3774 if (txmax > imgp[0]->width)
3775 txmax = imgp[0]->width;
3776 if (tymin < 0)
3777 tymin = 0;
3778 if (tymax > imgp[0]->height)
3779 tymax = imgp[0]->height;
3780 iterations++;
3781 }
3782 while (iterations < 10 && (txmin + 10 > txmax || tymin + 10 > tymax));
3783 }
3784 else
3785 {
3786 const int sz = 100;
3787 txmin = param.center.x - sz / 2;
3788 txmax = param.center.x + sz / 2;
3789 tymin = param.center.y - sz / 2;
3790 tymax = param.center.y + sz / 2;
3791 if (txmin < 0)
3792 txmin = 0;
3793 if (txmax > imgp[0]->width)
3794 txmax = imgp[0]->width;
3795 if (tymin < 0)
3796 tymin = 0;
3797 if (tymax > imgp[0]->height)
3798 tymax = imgp[0]->height;
3799 }
3800
3801 if (txmin + 10 > txmax || tymin + 10 > tymax)
3802 {
3803 if (verbose)
3804 {
3805 if (progress)
3806 progress->pause_stdout ();
3807 fprintf (stderr, "Too small tile %i-%i %i-%i\n", txmin, txmax, tymin,
3808 tymax);
3809 if (progress)
3810 progress->resume_stdout ();
3811 }
3812 ret.err = "too small tile";
3813 return ret;
3814 }
3815 int twidth = txmax - txmin + 1, theight = tymax - tymin + 1;
3816 if (verbose)
3817 {
3818 if (progress)
3819 progress->pause_stdout ();
3820 fprintf (stderr, "Tile size %ix%i; %i tiles\n", twidth, theight,
3821 n_tiles);
3822 if (progress)
3823 progress->resume_stdout ();
3824 }
3825 finetune_solver best_solver;
3826 coord_t best_uncertainty = -1;
3827 bool failed = false;
3828
3829 render_parameters rparam2 = rparam;
3830 /* Working with sharpened tile is easier, since it is likely already
3831 used by renderers. But if we are finetuning sharpening, we must
3832 use unsharpened data, so the parameters can be adjusted.
3833 TODO: It is not clear if sharpening does decrease quality of the
3834 simulation. */
3835 if (bw)
3836 {
3837 if (fparams.flags
3838 & (finetune_screen_blur | finetune_screen_channel_blurs
3839 | finetune_scanner_mtf_sigma | finetune_scanner_mtf_defocus))
3840 rparam2.sharpen.mode = sharpen_parameters::none;
3841 else
3842 tile_sharpened = true;
3843 }
3844
3845 /* TODO: shall we reset contact copy? */
3846 // rparam2.invert = 0;
3847 int maxtiles = fparams.multitile;
3848 if (maxtiles < 1)
3849 maxtiles = 1;
3850 if (!(maxtiles & 1))
3851 maxtiles++;
3852
3853 bool bw_is_simulated_infrared = false;
3854
3855 /* Multitile support only for 1 tile. */
3856 if (n_tiles == 1
3857 /* Avoid openmp when we do not need it. This seems also necessary to get
3858 Windows builds working. */
3859 && (maxtiles > 1 && !(fparams.flags & finetune_no_progress_report)))
3860 {
3862 // std::unique_ptr<render_to_scr> rp(new render_to_scr (param, img,
3863 // rparam, 256));
3864 render render (*imgp[0], rparam2, 256);
3865#if 0
3866 if (maxtiles > 1)
3867 {
3868 rxmin = std::max (txmin - twidth * (maxtiles / 2), 0);
3869 rymin = std::max (tymin - theight * (maxtiles / 2), 0);
3870 rxmax = std::max (txmax + (twidth * maxtiles / 2), imgp[0]->width - 1);

3872 }
3873 //if (!render.precompute_img_range (bw /*grayscale*/, false /*normalized*/, rxmin, rymin, rxmax + 1, rymax + 1, !(fparams.flags & finetune_no_progress_report) ? progress : nullptr))
3874#endif
3875 if (bw && (rparam2.ignore_infrared || !imgp[0]->has_grayscale_or_ir ()))
3876 bw_is_simulated_infrared = true;
3877 if (!render.precompute_all (
3878 bw /*grayscale*/, false /*normalized*/,
3879 patch_proportions (param.type, &rparam2),
3880 !(fparams.flags & finetune_no_progress_report) ? progress
3881 : nullptr))
3882 {
3883 if (verbose)
3884 {
3885 if (progress)
3886 progress->pause_stdout ();

3889 if (progress)
3890 progress->resume_stdout ();

3895 if (progress && progress->cancel_requested ())
3896 {
3897 ret.err = "cancelled";
3898 return ret;
3899 }
3900
3901 if (maxtiles * maxtiles > 1
3902 && !(fparams.flags & finetune_no_progress_report) && progress)
3903 progress->set_task ("finetuning samples", maxtiles * maxtiles);
3904
3905 gsl_error_handler_t *old_handler = gsl_set_error_handler_off ();
3906#pragma omp parallel for default(none) collapse(2) schedule(dynamic) \
3907 shared(fparams, maxtiles, rparam, pixel_size, best_uncertainty, verbose, \
3908 std::nothrow, imgp, twidth, theight, txmin, tymin, bw, \
3909 progress, mapp, render, failed, best_solver, results, \
3910 bw_is_simulated_infrared, tile_sharpened)
3911 for (int ty = 0; ty < maxtiles; ty++)
3912 for (int tx = 0; tx < maxtiles; tx++)
3913 {
3914 int cur_txmin = std::min (std::max (txmin - twidth * (maxtiles / 2)
3915 + tx * twidth,
3916 0),
3917 imgp[0]->width - twidth - 1)
3918 & ~1;
3919 int cur_tymin
3920 = std::min (std::max (tymin - theight * (maxtiles / 2)
3921 + ty * theight,
3922 0),
3923 imgp[0]->height - theight - 1)
3924 & ~1;
3925 // int cur_txmax = cur_txmin + twidth;
3926 // int cur_tymax = cur_tymin + theight;
3927 finetune_solver solver;
3928 solver.n_tiles = 1;
3929 solver.twidth = twidth;
3930 solver.theight = theight;
3931 solver.pixel_size = pixel_size;
3932 solver.render_sharpen_params = rparam.sharpen;
3933 solver.collection_threshold = rparam.collection_threshold;
3934 solver.parallel = !(fparams.flags & finetune_no_progress_report);
3935 if (!solver.init_tile (0, cur_txmin, cur_tymin, bw, *mapp[0],
3936 render))
3937 {
3938 failed = true;
3939 continue;
3940 }
3941 solver.init (fparams.flags, rparam.screen_blur_radius,
3942 rparam.red_strip_width, rparam.green_strip_width,
3943 bw_is_simulated_infrared, tile_sharpened, results);
3944 if (progress && progress->cancel_requested ())
3945 continue;
3946 coord_t uncertainty = solver.solve (
3947 progress, !(fparams.flags & finetune_no_progress_report)
3948 && maxtiles == 1);
3949
3950 if (maxtiles * maxtiles > 1
3951 && !(fparams.flags & finetune_no_progress_report) && progress)
3952 progress->inc_progress ();
3953#pragma omp critical
3954 {
3955 if (best_uncertainty < 0 || best_uncertainty > uncertainty)
3956 {
3957 best_solver = std::move (solver);
3958 best_uncertainty = uncertainty;
3959 }
3960 }
3961 }
3962 gsl_set_error_handler (old_handler);
3963 }
3964 else
3965 {
3966 best_solver.n_tiles = n_tiles;
3967 best_solver.twidth = twidth;
3968 best_solver.theight = theight;
3969 best_solver.collection_threshold = rparam.collection_threshold;
3970 best_solver.render_sharpen_params = rparam.sharpen;
3971 best_solver.pixel_size = pixel_size;
3972 best_solver.parallel = !(fparams.flags & finetune_no_progress_report);
3973 for (int tileid = 0; tileid < n_tiles; tileid++)
3974 {
3975 int cur_txmin = std::min (std::max (x[tileid] - twidth / 2, 0),
3976 imgp[tileid]->width - twidth - 1)
3977 & ~1;
3978 int cur_tymin = std::min (std::max (y[tileid] - theight / 2, 0),
3979 imgp[tileid]->height - theight - 1)
3980 & ~1;
3981 if (bw
3982 && (rparam2.ignore_infrared
3983 || !imgp[tileid]->has_grayscale_or_ir ()))
3984 bw_is_simulated_infrared = true;
3985 /* FIXME: We only use render_to_scr since we eventually want to know
3986 pixel size. For stitched projects this is wrong. */
3987 render render (*imgp[tileid], rparam2, 256);
3988 if (!render.precompute_all (
3989 bw /*grayscale*/, false /*normalized*/,
3990 patch_proportions (param.type, &rparam2),
3991 !(fparams.flags & finetune_no_progress_report) ? progress
3992 : nullptr))
3993 {
3994 ret.err = "precomputing failed";
3995 return ret;
3996 }
3997 if (progress && progress->cancel_requested ())
3998 {
3999 ret.err = "cancelled";
4000 return ret;
4001 }
4002 if (cur_txmin < 0 || cur_tymin < 0)
4003 {
4004 ret.err = "tile too large for image";
4005 return ret;
4006 }
4007 if (!best_solver.init_tile (tileid, cur_txmin, cur_tymin, bw,
4008 *mapp[tileid], render))
4009 {
4010 ret.err = "out of memory";
4011 return ret;
4012 }
4013 }
4014 best_solver.init (fparams.flags, rparam.screen_blur_radius,
4015 rparam.red_strip_width, rparam.green_strip_width,
4016 bw_is_simulated_infrared, tile_sharpened, results);
4017 gsl_error_handler_t *old_handler = gsl_set_error_handler_off ();
4018 /* Wild guessing needs brute forcing scale and rotation. */
4019 if (best_solver.optimize_coordinates == 2)
4020 {
4021 best_uncertainty = -1;
4022 /* Limit angles and assume that original is scanned in sane position. */
4023 static constexpr coord_t paget_angles[][2]={{-5,5},{-15,-5},{5,15},{-25,-15},{15,25}};
4024 const int n_paget_angles = sizeof (paget_angles) / sizeof (coord_t[2]);
4025
4026 /* Dufay is rotated by 23 degrees and it is not symmetric. */
4027 constexpr coord_t dufay_a = 23;
4028 static constexpr coord_t dufay_angles[][2]
4029 ={{dufay_a-5,dufay_a+5}, {dufay_a-15,dufay_a-5}, {dufay_a+5,dufay_a+15},
4030 {dufay_a-5+90,dufay_a+5+90}, {dufay_a-15+90,dufay_a-5+90}, {dufay_a+5+90,dufay_a+15+90}};
4031
4032 const int n_dufay_angles = sizeof (dufay_angles) / sizeof (coord_t[2]);
4033
4034 const coord_t (*angles)[2] = paget_angles;
4035 int n_angles = n_paget_angles;
4036
4037 if (param.type == Dufay)
4038 {
4039 angles = dufay_angles;
4040 n_angles = n_dufay_angles;
4041 }
4042
4043
4044#pragma omp parallel for default(none) schedule(dynamic) collapse(2) shared( \
4045 fparams, rparam, pixel_size, best_uncertainty, verbose, imgp, twidth, \
4046 theight, txmin, tymin, bw, progress, mapp, failed, best_solver, \
4047 results, bw_is_simulated_infrared, tile_sharpened, n_angles, angles)
4048 for (int i = 0; i < 50; i++)
4049 {
4050 for (int rot = 0; rot < n_angles; rot ++)
4051 {
4052 finetune_solver solver;
4053 solver.n_tiles = 1;
4054 solver.twidth = twidth;
4055 solver.theight = theight;
4056 solver.collection_threshold = rparam.collection_threshold;
4057 solver.render_sharpen_params = rparam.sharpen;
4058 solver.pixel_size = pixel_size;
4059 solver.parallel
4060 = !(fparams.flags & finetune_no_progress_report);
4061
4062 bool r;
4063#pragma omp critical
4064 r = solver.copy_tile (0, best_solver);
4065 if (!r)
4066 failed = true;
4067 solver.min_scale = geom_sequence (1/50.0, 1/1.5, 50, i);
4068 solver.max_scale = geom_sequence (1/50.0, 1/1.5, 50, i+1);
4069 solver.min_rotate = angles[rot][0];
4070 solver.max_rotate = angles[rot][1];
4071 solver.init (
4072 fparams.flags, rparam.screen_blur_radius,
4073 rparam.red_strip_width, rparam.green_strip_width,
4074 bw_is_simulated_infrared, tile_sharpened, results);
4075 coord_t u = solver.solve (
4076 progress,
4077 !(fparams.flags & finetune_no_progress_report));
4078 //printf ("step %i rotate %i %f %f %f\n", i, rot, u, solver.get_scale (solver.start.data ()), solver.get_rotation (solver.start.data ()));
4079#pragma omp critical
4080 {
4081 if (best_uncertainty < 0 || best_uncertainty > u)
4082 {
4083 best_solver = std::move (solver);
4084 best_uncertainty = u;
4085 }
4086 }
4087 }
4088 }
4089 if (failed)
4090 {
4091 ret.err = "out of memory";
4092 return ret;
4093 }
4094 }
4095 else
4096 best_uncertainty = best_solver.solve (
4097 progress, !(fparams.flags & finetune_no_progress_report));
4098 gsl_set_error_handler (old_handler);
4099 }
4100 if (progress && progress->cancel_requested ())
4101 {
4102 ret.err = "cancelled";
4103 return ret;
4104 }
4105 if (failed)
4106 {
4107 ret.err = "failed memory allocation";
4108 return ret;
4109 }
4110 if (best_uncertainty < 0)
4111 {
4112 ret.err = "negative uncertainty";
4113 return ret;
4114 }
4115
4116 if (best_solver.least_squares)
4117 {
4118 best_solver.alloc_least_squares ();
4119 if (!best_solver.optimize_fog || best_solver.fog_by_least_squares)
4120 best_solver.init_least_squares (best_solver.start.data ());
4121 }
4122 if (!best_solver.tiles[0].color.empty () && fparams.ignore_outliers > 0)
4123 best_solver.determine_outliers (best_solver.start.data (),
4124 fparams.ignore_outliers);
4125 else if (fparams.ignore_outliers > 0)
4126 best_solver.bw_determine_outliers (best_solver.start.data (),
4127 fparams.ignore_outliers);
4128 if (best_solver.has_outliers ())
4129 simplex<coord_t, finetune_solver> (
4130 best_solver, "finetuning with outliers", progress,
4131 !(fparams.flags & finetune_no_progress_report));
4132 if (progress && progress->cancel_requested ())
4133 {
4134 ret.err = "cancelled";
4135 return ret;
4136 }
4137
4138 ret.uncertainty = best_uncertainty;
4139 if (verbose)
4140 {
4141 if (progress)
4142 progress->pause_stdout ();
4143 best_solver.print_values (best_solver.start.data ());
4144 if (progress)
4145 progress->resume_stdout ();
4146 }
4147 best_solver.set_results (ret, param, rparam, verbose, progress);
4148
4149 if (fparams.simulated_file)
4150 best_solver.write_file (best_solver.start.data (), fparams.simulated_file,
4151 0, 0);
4152 if (fparams.orig_file)
4153 best_solver.write_file (best_solver.start.data (), fparams.orig_file, 0,
4154 1);
4155 if (fparams.sharpened_file)
4156 best_solver.write_file (best_solver.start.data (), fparams.sharpened_file,
4157 0, 3);
4158 if (fparams.diff_file)
4159 best_solver.write_file (best_solver.start.data (), fparams.diff_file, 0,
4160 2);
4161 if (fparams.flags & finetune_produce_images)
4162 {
4163 ret.simulated
4164 = best_solver.produce_image (best_solver.start.data (), 0, 0);
4165 ret.orig = best_solver.produce_image (best_solver.start.data (), 0, 1);
4166 if (best_solver.optimize_sharpening)
4167 ret.sharpened
4168 = best_solver.produce_image (best_solver.start.data (), 0, 3);
4169 ret.diff = best_solver.produce_image (best_solver.start.data (), 0, 2);
4170 if (fparams.screen_blur_file)
4171 {
4172 screen tmp;
4173 best_solver.collect_screen (&tmp, best_solver.start.data (), 0);
4174 screen scr, scr1;
4175 scr.initialize (
4176 best_solver.type,
4177 best_solver.get_red_strip_width (best_solver.start.data ()),
4178 best_solver.get_green_strip_width (best_solver.start.data ()));
4179 best_solver.apply_blur (best_solver.start.data (), 0, &scr, &scr1);
4180 ret.dot_spread = scr.get_image (true, 1);
4181 }
4182 ret.screen = best_solver.original_scr->get_image ();
4183 ret.blurred_screen = best_solver.tiles[0].scr->get_image ();
4184 if (best_solver.optimize_emulsion_blur)
4185 ret.emulsion_screen = best_solver.emulsion_scr->get_image ();
4186 if (best_solver.optimize_emulsion_intensities)
4187 ret.merged_screen = best_solver.tiles[0].merged_scr->get_image ();
4188
4189 screen tmp;
4190 best_solver.collect_screen (&tmp, best_solver.start.data (), 0);
4191 ret.collected_screen = tmp.get_image ();
4192
4193 screen scr, scr1;
4194 scr1.initialize_dot ();
4195 best_solver.apply_blur (best_solver.start.data (), 0, &scr, &scr1);
4196 ret.dot_spread = scr.get_image (true, 1);
4197 }
4198 if (fparams.screen_file)
4199 best_solver.original_scr->save_tiff (fparams.screen_file);
4200 if (fparams.screen_blur_file)
4201 best_solver.tiles[0].scr->save_tiff (fparams.screen_blur_file);
4202 if (best_solver.emulsion_scr && fparams.emulsion_file)
4203 best_solver.emulsion_scr->save_tiff (fparams.emulsion_file);
4204 if (best_solver.tiles[0].merged_scr && fparams.merged_file)
4205 best_solver.tiles[0].merged_scr->save_tiff (fparams.merged_file);
4206 if (fparams.collected_file)
4207 {
4208 screen tmp;
4209 best_solver.collect_screen (&tmp, best_solver.start.data (), 0);
4210 tmp.save_tiff (fparams.collected_file);
4211 }
4212 if (fparams.dot_spread_file)
4213 {
4214 screen scr, scr1;
4215 scr1.initialize_dot ();
4216 best_solver.apply_blur (best_solver.start.data (), 0, &scr, &scr1);
4217 scr.save_tiff (fparams.dot_spread_file, true, 1);
4218 }
4219 // printf ("%i %i %i %i %f %f %f %f\n", bx, by, fsx, fsy,
4220 // best_solver.tile_pos[twidth/2+(theight/2)*twidth].x,
4221 // best_solver.tile_pos[twidth/2+(theight/2)*twidth].y, fp.x, fp.y);
4222 return ret;
4223}
4224
4225/* Finetune SOLVER parameters in given AREA using RPARAM and PARAM in IMG.
4226 PROGRESS is used to report progress.
4227 Assume the registration is correct only in existing points in AREA.
4228 Start from these and try to carefully insert new points. */
4229
4230DLL_PUBLIC bool
4231finetune_misregistered_area (solver_parameters *solver,
4232 render_parameters & rparam,
4233 const scr_to_img_parameters & param,
4234 const image_data & img,
4235 const int_image_area & in_area,
4236 const finetune_area_parameters & fparam,
4237 progress_info *progress)
4238{
4239 int_image_area area = in_area.intersect ({ 0, 0, img.width, img.height });
4240 const bool verbose = false;
4241 if (area.empty_p () || param.type == Random)
4242 {
4243 if (verbose)
4244 printf ("Finetuning area failed since area is empty or screen is "
4245 "Random\n");
4246 return false;
4247 }
4248 int xsteps, ysteps;
4249 fparam.get_grid_dimensions (area, param, &xsteps, &ysteps);
4250 if (!xsteps || !ysteps)
4251 {
4252 if (verbose)
4253 printf ("Finetuning area failed since xsteps or ysteps is 0\n");
4254 return false;
4255 }
4256 int_image_area crop = rparam.get_scan_crop (img.width, img.height);
4257 int xstep = std::max (1, crop.width / xsteps);
4258 int ystep = std::max (1, crop.height / ysteps);
4259 if (verbose)
4260 printf ("Aiming for %ix%i grid, steps %ix%i\n", xsteps, ysteps, xstep,
4261 ystep);
4262
4263 int max_points = 10000;
4264
4265 if (!solver->points.size ())
4266 {
4267 /* If registration seem to make sense, try to expand it. */
4268 if (!area.contains_p (
4269 {
4270 (int) param.center.x, (int) param.center.y})
4271 || param.coordinate1.length () < 3
4272 || param.coordinate2.length () < 3)
4273 {
4274 if (verbose)
4275 printf ("Finetuning area failed since there are no solver points "
4276 "and coordinate system starts elsewhere\n");
4277 return false;
4278 }
4279 finetune_parameters fparam;
4280 fparam.flags |= finetune_position /*| finetune_multitile */ | finetune_bw
4281 | finetune_no_progress_report;
4282 finetune_result res = finetune (rparam, param, img, { param.center },
4283 nullptr, fparam, progress);
4284 finetune_result res2
4285 = finetune (rparam, param, img, { param.center + param.coordinate1 },
4286 nullptr, fparam, progress);
4287 finetune_result res3
4288 = finetune (rparam, param, img, { param.center + param.coordinate2 },
4289 nullptr, fparam, progress);
4290 if (!res.success || !res2.success || !res3.success)
4291 {
4292 if (verbose)
4293 printf ("Finetuning area failed since we failed to identify 3 "
4294 "basis points\n");
4295 return false;
4296 }
4297 solver->add_point (res.solver_point_img_location,
4298 res.solver_point_screen_location,
4299 res.solver_point_color);
4300 solver->add_or_modify_point (res2.solver_point_img_location,
4301 res2.solver_point_screen_location,
4302 res2.solver_point_color);
4303 solver->add_or_modify_point (res3.solver_point_img_location,
4304 res3.solver_point_screen_location,
4305 res3.solver_point_color);
4306 max_points = 50;
4307 xstep =
4308 my_ceil (std::
4309 max (fabs (param.coordinate1.x),
4310 fabs (param.coordinate2.x)));
4311 ystep =
4312 my_ceil (std::
4313 max (fabs (param.coordinate1.y),
4314 fabs (param.coordinate2.y)));
4315 if (verbose)
4316 printf ("Finetuning area started by adding basis, steps %i %i\n",
4317 xstep, ystep);
4318 }
4319 /* See if points are corelated around a line. In this case the current
4320 solution is probably quite iffy and we need to expand slowly. */
4321 else if (solver->points.size () < 10000)
4322 {
4323 point_t origin, dir;
4324 double line_width = solver->fit_line (origin, dir);
4325 const int ratio = 5;
4326 if (xstep > line_width / ratio)
4327 {
4328 xstep = my_ceil ((line_width) / ratio);
4329 max_points = 50;
4330 }
4331 if (ystep > line_width / ratio)
4332 {
4333 ystep = my_ceil ((line_width) / ratio);
4334 max_points = 50;
4335 }
4336 }
4337
4338 /* Too small step will lead to re-solving existing points only. */
4339 xstep = std::max (xstep,
4340 (int) my_ceil (std::max (fabs (param.coordinate1.x),
4341 fabs (param.coordinate2.x)) *
4342 2));
4343 ystep =
4344 std::max (ystep,
4345 (int) my_ceil (std::
4346 max (fabs (param.coordinate1.y),
4347 fabs (param.coordinate2.y)) * 2));
4348
4349 /* We may end up with very large grid; limit it to maximal search distance
4350 so we do not end up allocating very large grid. */
4351 if (max_points < 1000)
4352 {
4353 int xmin = INT_MAX;
4354 int ymin = INT_MAX;
4355 int xmax = INT_MIN;
4356 int ymax = INT_MIN;
4357 for (auto p:solver->points)
4358 if (area.contains_p (
4359 {
4360 (int) p.img.x, (int) p.img.y}))
4361 {
4362 xmin = std::min (xmin, (int) p.img.x);
4363 ymin = std::min (ymin, (int) p.img.y);
4364 xmax = std::max (xmax, (int) p.img.x);
4365 ymax = std::max (ymax, (int) p.img.y);
4366 }
4367 int_image_area max_search_range
4368 {
4369 xmin - xstep * max_points, ymin - ystep * max_points,
4370 xmax - xmin + xstep * max_points * 2,
4371 ymax - ymin + ystep * max_points * 2};
4372 if (verbose)
4373 printf ("Intersecting with range %i %i %i %i\n", max_search_range.x,
4374 max_search_range.y, max_search_range.width,
4375 max_search_range.height);
4376 area = area.intersect (max_search_range);
4377 }
4378
4379 const int range = 3;
4380 int xsubstep = std::max (1, xstep / range);
4381 int ysubstep = std::max (1, ystep / range);
4382 int xsubsteps = std::max (1, (area.width + xsubstep - 1) / xsubstep);
4383 int ysubsteps = std::max (1, (area.height + ysubstep - 1) / ysubstep);
4384 int npoints;
4385 int nfound = 0;
4386 coord_t max_uncertainty = 10000;
4387
4388 enum elt
4389 {
4390 unknown,
4391 known,
4392 to_be_computed,
4393 bad
4394 };
4395
4396 std::vector < elt > tiles (xsubsteps * ysubsteps, unknown);
4397
4398 const auto get_cell_pos =[area, xsubstep, ysubstep] (point_t p)->int_point_t {
4399 return {(int64_t) my_floor ((p.x - area.x) / (coord_t) xsubstep),
4400 (int64_t) my_floor ((p.y - area.y) / (coord_t) ysubstep)};
4401 };
4402 const auto in_range =[xsubsteps, ysubsteps] (int_point_t p)->bool {
4403 return p.x >= 0 && p.x < xsubsteps && p.y >= 0 && p.y < ysubsteps;
4404 };
4405 const auto set_cell =
4406 [in_range, &tiles, xsubsteps] (int_point_t p, enum elt value)->void {
4407 if (in_range (p))
4408 tiles[p.y * xsubsteps + p.x] = value;
4409 };
4410 const auto get_cell =[in_range, &tiles, xsubsteps] (int_point_t p)->elt {
4411 assert (in_range (p));
4412 return tiles[p.y * xsubsteps + p.x];
4413 };
4414
4415 if (verbose)
4416 printf ("Adding points to area with top left (%i,%i) width %i height %i, "
4417 "steps %i %i size %i %i with known points %i\n",
4418 area.x, area.y, area.width, area.height, xsubsteps, ysubsteps,
4419 xsubstep, ysubstep, (int) solver->points.size ());
4420for (auto p:solver->points)
4421 set_cell (get_cell_pos (p.img), known);
4422
4423 /* This is essentialy an floodfill. If there is 3x3 tile
4424 with no known data such that just outside of it exists
4425 known point; enqueue its center for finetuning. */
4426 do
4427 {
4428 std::vector < point_t > points;
4429 for (int y = range; y < ysubsteps - range; y++)
4430 for (int x = range; x < xsubsteps - range; x++)
4431 {
4432 bool ok = true;
4433 /* If range is 3 we search
4434
4435 b b b b b b b
4436 b . . . . . p
4437 b . . . . . p
4438 b . . p . . p
4439 b . . . . . p
4440 b . . . . . p
4441 b b b b b b b
4442
4443 p is the tile we consider to compute points n.
4444 . is required to have no control point
4445 b is required to have at least one control point.
4446
4447 So at the end, the computed points should approximately
4448 make grid with spacing of 3
4449
4450 p . . p . . p
4451 . . . . . . .
4452 . . . . . . .
4453 p . . p . . p
4454 . . . . . . .
4455 . . . . . . .
4456 p . . p . . p */
4457 for (int yy = y - range + 1; yy <= y + range - 1 && ok; yy++)
4458 for (int xx = x - range + 1; xx <= x + range - 1 && ok; xx++)
4459 if (get_cell (
4460 {
4461 xx, yy}
4462 ) != unknown)
4463 ok = false;
4464 if (!ok)
4465 continue;
4466 int nknown = 0;
4467 for (int yy = y - range; yy <= y + range; yy++)
4468 for (int xx = x - range; xx <= x + range; xx++)
4469 if (get_cell (
4470 {
4471 xx, yy}
4472 ) == known)
4473 nknown++;
4474 if (!nknown)
4475 continue;
4476 set_cell (
4477 {
4478 x, y}
4479 , to_be_computed);
4480 points.push_back (
4481 {
4482 ((x + (coord_t) 0.5) * xsubstep) + area.x,
4483 ((y + (coord_t) 0.5) * ysubstep) + area.y}
4484 );
4485 assert ((get_cell_pos (points.back ()) == (int_point_t)
4486 {
4487 x, y}
4488 ));
4489 if (verbose && 0)
4490 printf ("Will compute %i %i\n", x, y);
4491 }
4492 if (!points.size ())
4493 break;
4494 if (progress)
4495 progress->set_task ("finetuning points nearby known points",
4496 points.size ());
4497 std::vector < finetune_result > res (points.size ());
4498 /* We are going to initialize render inside of nested region.
4499 TODO: We probably want to set omp_nested on proper place. */
4500#ifdef _OPENMP
4501 omp_set_max_active_levels (3);
4502#endif
4503#pragma omp parallel for default(none) schedule(dynamic) \
4504 shared(rparam, param, progress, img, solver, res, points)
4505 for (size_t i = 0; i < points.size (); i++)
4506 {
4507 if (progress && progress->cancel_requested ())
4508 continue;
4509 finetune_parameters fparam;
4510 fparam.flags |= finetune_position /*| finetune_multitile */ | finetune_bw
4511 | finetune_no_progress_report;
4512 res[i] = finetune (rparam, param, img,
4513 {
4514 points[i]}
4515 , nullptr, fparam, progress);
4516 if (progress)
4517 progress->inc_progress ();
4518 }
4519 if (progress && progress->cancel_requested ())
4520 {
4521 if (verbose)
4522 printf ("Finetuning area cancelled\n");
4523 return false;
4524 }
4525 if (progress)
4526 progress->set_task ("processing points found", 1);
4527
4528 scr_to_img map;
4529 if (!map.set_parameters (param, img))
4530 {
4531 if (verbose)
4532 printf ("Finetuning area failed since it failed to initialize "
4533 "scr-to-img\n");
4534 return false;
4535 }
4536
4537 /* Clear info about points to be computed. */
4538 for (int i = 0; i < xsubsteps * ysubsteps; i++)
4539 if (tiles[i] == to_be_computed)
4540 tiles[i] = unknown;
4541 npoints = 0;
4542 if (verbose)
4543 printf ("Will consider %i results\n", (int) res.size ());
4544 /* Now prune points that seems badr. */
4545 for (size_t i = 0; i < res.size ();)
4546 {
4547 finetune_result & r = res[i];
4548 bool ok = r.success;
4549 if (!r.success)
4550 ok = false;
4551 else
4552 if (fabs
4553 (get_cell_pos (r.solver_point_img_location).x -
4554 get_cell_pos (points[i]).x) > 3
4555 || fabs (get_cell_pos (r.solver_point_img_location).y -
4556 get_cell_pos (points[i]).y) > 3)
4557 {
4558 if (verbose)
4559 printf
4560 ("found point: %f %f which is too far from desired location %f %f\n",
4561 r.solver_point_img_location.x,
4562 r.solver_point_img_location.y, points[i].x, points[i].y);
4563 set_cell (get_cell_pos (r.solver_point_img_location), bad);
4564 ok = false;
4565 }
4566 /* Point must be new. */
4567 else if (solver->find_point (r.solver_point_screen_location) >= 0)
4568 {
4569 if (verbose)
4570 printf ("found point: %f %f which already exists\n",
4571 r.solver_point_img_location.x,
4572 r.solver_point_img_location.y);
4573 set_cell (get_cell_pos (r.solver_point_img_location), known);
4574 ok = false;
4575 }
4576 /* Check contrast to be within threshold. */
4577 else if (r.contrast < fparam.min_contrast)
4578 {
4579 if (verbose)
4580 printf ("found point: %f %f with too small contrast %f\n",
4581 r.solver_point_img_location.x,
4582 r.solver_point_img_location.y, r.contrast);
4583 set_cell (get_cell_pos (r.solver_point_img_location), bad);
4584 ok = false;
4585 }
4586 /* Check distance threshold. */
4587 else
4588 {
4589 point_t transformed = map.to_scr (r.solver_point_img_location);
4590 ok = transformed.dist_from (r.solver_point_screen_location)
4591 < fparam.max_displacement;
4592 int_point_t cell = get_cell_pos (r.solver_point_img_location);
4593 if (!ok)
4594 set_cell (cell, bad);
4595 if (verbose)
4596 printf ("found grid: %i %i transformed: %f %f finetuned: %f "
4597 "%f displacement %f %s\n",
4598 (int) cell.x, (int) cell.y, transformed.x,
4599 transformed.y, r.solver_point_screen_location.x,
4600 r.solver_point_screen_location.y,
4601 transformed.dist_from (r.
4602 solver_point_screen_location),
4603 ok ? "in threshold" : "out of threshold");
4604 }
4605 if (!ok)
4606 {
4607 res[i] = std::move (res.back ());
4608 res.pop_back ();
4609 points[i] = std::move (points.back ());
4610 points.pop_back ();
4611 }
4612 else
4613 i++;
4614 }
4615 if (verbose)
4616 printf ("Will consider %i meaningful results\n", (int) res.size ());
4617 /* If we have many points; rule out uncertain ones. Let the value only
4618 drop in each wave. */
4619 if (res.size () > 5)
4620 {
4621 std::sort (res.begin (), res.end (),
4622 [](finetune_result & a, finetune_result & b)
4623 {
4624 return a.uncertainty > b.uncertainty;
4625 }
4626 );
4627 max_uncertainty = std::min (max_uncertainty,
4628 res[(res.size () - 1) * (1 -
4629 fparam.
4630 uncertainty_ratio)].
4631 uncertainty);
4632 }
4633
4634 /* Now add computed points to solver and update tiles. */
4635 for (size_t i = 0; i < res.size (); i++)
4636 {
4637 finetune_result & r = res[i];
4638 int_point_t cell = get_cell_pos (r.solver_point_img_location);
4639 if (r.uncertainty <= max_uncertainty
4640 && solver->find_point (r.solver_point_screen_location) < 0)
4641 {
4642 solver->add_point (r.solver_point_img_location,
4643 r.solver_point_screen_location,
4644 r.solver_point_color);
4645 set_cell (cell, known);
4646 nfound++;
4647 npoints++;
4648 }
4649 else
4650 {
4651 if (verbose)
4652 printf ("Bad point %f %f %i\n", r.uncertainty, max_uncertainty,solver->find_point (r.solver_point_screen_location));
4653 set_cell (cell, bad);
4654 }
4655 }
4656 if (nfound > max_points)
4657 {
4658 if (verbose)
4659 printf ("reached max points of %i\n", max_points);
4660 return true;
4661 }
4662 }
4663 while (npoints);
4664 if (verbose)
4665 printf ("found %i points\n", nfound);
4666 return true;
4667}
4668
4669/* Finetune SOLVER parameters in given AREA using RPARAM and PARAM in IMG.
4670 PROGRESS is used to report progress. */
4671
4672DLL_PUBLIC bool
4673finetune_area (solver_parameters *solver, render_parameters &rparam,
4674 const scr_to_img_parameters &param, const image_data &img,
4675 const int_image_area &in_area,
4676 const finetune_area_parameters &fparam,
4677 progress_info *progress)
4678{
4679 int_image_area area = in_area.intersect ({ 0, 0, img.width, img.height });
4680 if (area.empty_p ())
4681 return false;
4682 int xsteps, ysteps;
4683 fparam.get_grid_dimensions (area, param, &xsteps, &ysteps);
4684 if (!xsteps || !ysteps)
4685 return false;
4686 int_image_area crop = rparam.get_scan_crop (img.width, img.height);
4687 int xstep = std::max (1, crop.width / xsteps);
4688 int ystep = std::max (1, crop.height / ysteps);
4689 xsteps = (area.width + xstep - 1) / xstep;
4690 ysteps = (area.height + ystep - 1) / ystep;
4691 if (!xsteps || !ysteps)
4692 return false;
4693 std::vector<finetune_result> res (xsteps * ysteps);
4694 if (progress)
4695 progress->set_task ("finetuning grid", ysteps * xsteps);
4696 /* We are going to initialize render inside of nested region.
4697 TODO: We probably want to set omp_nested on proper place. */
4698#ifdef _OPENMP
4699 omp_set_max_active_levels (3);
4700#endif
4701 if (xsteps > 1 || ysteps > 1)
4702 {
4703#pragma omp parallel for default(none) collapse(2) schedule(dynamic) \
4704 shared(xsteps, ysteps, rparam, param, progress, img, solver, res, area, \
4705 xstep, ystep)
4706 for (int x = 0; x < xsteps; x++)
4707 for (int y = 0; y < ysteps; y++)
4708 {
4709 if (progress && progress->cancel_requested ())
4710 continue;
4711 finetune_parameters fparam;
4712 fparam.flags
4713 |= finetune_position /*| finetune_multitile*/ | finetune_bw
4714 | finetune_no_progress_report;
4715 res[x + y * xsteps] = finetune (
4716 rparam, param, img,
4717 { { (coord_t)area.x + (x /*+ 0.5*/) * xstep, (coord_t)area.y + (y /*+ 0.5*/) * ystep } },
4718 nullptr, fparam, progress);
4719 if (progress)
4720 progress->inc_progress ();
4721 }
4722 }
4723 else if (!progress || !progress->cancel_requested ())
4724 {
4725 finetune_parameters fparam;
4726 fparam.flags |= finetune_position /*| finetune_multitile*/ | finetune_bw;
4727 res[0]
4728 = finetune (rparam, param, img,
4729 { { (coord_t)area.x + /*(0.5) **/ xstep, (coord_t)area.y /*+ (0.5) * ystep*/ } },
4730 nullptr, fparam, progress);
4731 if (progress)
4732 progress->inc_progress ();
4733 }
4734 if (progress && progress->cancel_requested ())
4735 return false;
4736 std::sort (res.begin (), res.end (),
4737 [] (finetune_result &a, finetune_result &b)
4738 { return a.uncertainty > b.uncertainty; });
4739 coord_t max_uncertainty = res[(xsteps * ysteps - 1) * (1 - fparam.uncertainty_ratio)].uncertainty;
4740 for (int x = 0; x < xsteps; x++)
4741 for (int y = 0; y < ysteps; y++)
4742 {
4743 finetune_result &r = res[x + y * xsteps];
4744 if (r.success && r.uncertainty <= max_uncertainty
4745 && r.contrast > fparam.min_contrast
4746 && solver->find_point (r.solver_point_screen_location) < 0)
4747 {
4748 solver->add_point (r.solver_point_img_location,
4749 r.solver_point_screen_location,
4750 r.solver_point_color);
4751 }
4752 }
4753 return true;
4754}
4755
4756/* Simulate data collection of scan of given color screen (assumed to be
4757 blurred) and return collected red, green and blue. This can be used to
4758 increase color saturation to compensate losses caused by the collection.
4759
4760 RET_RED, RET_GREEN, RET_BLUE are returned colors.
4761 SCR is screen used to render the pattern, while COLLECTION_SCR is used to do
4762 the data collection. SIMULATED_SCREEN is optional simulated screen.
4763 THRESHOLD is the collection threshold. SHARPEN_PARAM are sharpen
4764 parameters. MAP is the scr-to-img map. AREA defines the area. */
4765
4766bool
4767determine_color_loss (rgbdata *ret_red, rgbdata *ret_green, rgbdata *ret_blue,
4768 screen &scr, screen &collection_scr,
4769 simulated_screen *simulated_screen,
4770 luminosity_t threshold,
4771 const sharpen_parameters &sharpen_param, scr_to_img &map,
4772 int_image_area area)
4773{
4774 double_rgbdata red = { 0, 0, 0 }, green = { 0, 0, 0 }, blue = { 0, 0, 0 };
4775 double wr = 0, wg = 0, wb = 0;
4776 const bool debugfiles = false;
4777
4778 if (debugfiles)
4779 {
4780 scr.save_tiff ("/tmp/scr.tif", false, 3);
4781 collection_scr.save_tiff ("/tmp/collection-scr.tif", false, 3);
4782 }
4783
4784 sharpen_parameters::sharpen_mode sharpen_mode = sharpen_param.get_mode ();
4785 if (simulated_screen)
4786 {
4787// FIXME: prallelism here seems to cause instability (race condition)
4788#if 0
4789#pragma omp declare reduction(+ : double_rgbdata : omp_out = omp_out + omp_in)
4790#pragma omp parallel for default(none) collapse(2) \
4791 shared(area, threshold, simulated_screen) \
4792 reduction(+ : wr, wg, wb, red, green, blue)
4793#endif
4794 for (int y = area.y; y < area.y + area.height; y++)
4795 for (int x = area.x; x < area.x + area.width; x++)
4796 {
4797 /* Collection and screen colors are the same. */
4798 rgbdata m = simulated_screen->get_pixel (y, x);
4799 if (m.red > threshold)
4800 {
4801 luminosity_t val = m.red - threshold;
4802 wr += val;
4803 red += m * val;
4804 }
4805 if (m.green > threshold)
4806 {
4807 luminosity_t val = m.green - threshold;
4808 wg += val;
4809 green += m * val;
4810 }
4811 if (m.blue > threshold)
4812 {
4813 luminosity_t val = m.blue - threshold;
4814 wb += val;
4815 blue += m * val;
4816 }
4817 }
4818 }
4819 /* If sharpening is not needed, we can avoid temporary buffer to store
4820 rendered screen. */
4821 else if (sharpen_mode == sharpen_parameters::none)
4822 {
4823 bool antialias = !sharpen_param.scanner_mtf_scale;
4824// FIXME: prallelism here seems to cause instability (race condition)
4825#if 0
4826#pragma omp declare reduction(+ : double_rgbdata : omp_out = omp_out + omp_in)
4827#pragma omp parallel for default(none) collapse(2) \
4828 shared(area, threshold, map, scr, collection_scr,antialias) \
4829 reduction(+ : wr, wg, wb, red, green, blue)
4830#endif
4831 for (int y = area.y; y < area.y + area.height; y++)
4832 for (int x = area.x; x < area.x + area.width; x++)
4833 {
4834 point_t p;
4835 rgbdata am;
4836 /* Render screen.
4837 Scanner MTF already estimates sensor loss; so we should not need
4838 to antialias. */
4839 if (!antialias)
4840 am = noantialias_screen (scr, map, x, y, &p);
4841 else
4842 am = antialias_screen (scr, map, x, y, &p);
4843 /* Data collection does not antialias. So just take pixel in the
4844 middle */
4845 rgbdata m = collection_scr.noninterpolated_mult (p);
4846 if (m.red > threshold)
4847 {
4848 luminosity_t val = m.red - threshold;
4849 wr += val;
4850 red += am * val;
4851 }
4852 if (m.green > threshold)
4853 {
4854 luminosity_t val = m.green - threshold;
4855 wg += val;
4856 green += am * val;
4857 }
4858 if (m.blue > threshold)
4859 {
4860 luminosity_t val = m.blue - threshold;
4861 wb += val;
4862 blue += am * val;
4863 }
4864 }
4865 }
4866 else
4867 {
4868 int ext;
4869 if (sharpen_param.deconvolution_p ())
4870 {
4871 std::shared_ptr<mtf> cur_mtf
4872 = mtf::get_mtf (sharpen_param.scanner_mtf, nullptr);
4873 if (!cur_mtf->precompute ())
4874 return false;
4875 ext = cur_mtf->psf_size (sharpen_param.scanner_mtf_scale);
4876 }
4877 else
4878 ext = fir_blur::convolve_matrix_length (sharpen_param.usm_radius) / 2;
4879 int xsize = area.width + 2 * ext;
4880 int ysize = area.height + 2 * ext;
4881 std::vector<rgbdata> rendered (xsize * ysize);
4882
4883 /* Render screen.
4884 Scanner MTF already estimates sensor loss; so we should not need to
4885 antialias. */
4886 if (sharpen_param.scanner_mtf_scale)
4887 for (int y = area.y - ext; y < area.y + area.height + ext; y++)
4888 for (int x = area.x - ext; x < area.x + area.width + ext; x++)
4889 rendered[(y - area.y + ext) * xsize + x - area.x + ext]
4890 = noantialias_screen (scr, map, x, y);
4891 else
4892 for (int y = area.y - ext; y < area.y + area.height + ext; y++)
4893 for (int x = area.x - ext; x < area.x + area.width + ext; x++)
4894 rendered[(y - area.y + ext) * xsize + x - area.x + ext]
4895 = antialias_screen (scr, map, x, y);
4896
4897 /* Sharpen it */
4898 std::vector<rgbdata> rendered2 (xsize * ysize);
4899 /* FIXME: parallelism is disabled because sometimes we are called from
4900 * parallel block. */
4901 if (!sharpen_param.deconvolution_p ())
4902 sharpen<rgbdata, rgbdata, rgbdata *, int, getdata_helper> (
4903 rendered2.data (), rendered.data (), xsize, ysize, ysize,
4904 sharpen_param.usm_radius, sharpen_param.usm_amount, nullptr,
4905 false);
4906 else
4907 {
4908 if (!deconvolve_rgb<rgbdata, rgbdata, rgbdata *, int, getdata_helper> (
4909 rendered2.data (), rendered.data (), xsize, ysize, ysize,
4910 sharpen_param, nullptr, false))
4911 return false;
4912 }
4913
4914 if (debugfiles)
4915 {
4916 tiff_writer_params p;
4917 void *buffer;
4918 size_t len = create_linear_srgb_profile (&buffer);
4919 p.icc_profile = buffer;
4920 p.icc_profile_len = len;
4921 p.filename = "/tmp/sharpened.tif";
4922 p.width = xsize;
4923 p.height = ysize;
4924 p.depth = 16;
4925 const char *error;
4926 {
4927 tiff_writer renderedt (p, &error);
4928 for (int y = area.y - ext; y < area.y + area.height + ext; y++)
4929 {
4930 for (int x = area.x - ext; x < area.x + area.width + ext; x++)
4931 {
4932 rgbdata d
4933 = rendered2[(y - area.y + ext) * xsize + x - area.x + ext];
4934 if (x == area.x - 1 || y == area.y - 1 || x == area.x + area.width
4935 || y == area.y + area.height)
4936 d = { 1, 1, 1 };
4937 renderedt.put_pixel (
4938 x - area.x + ext,
4939 std::clamp (d.red, (luminosity_t)0, (luminosity_t)1)
4940 * (luminosity_t)65535,
4941 std::clamp (d.green, (luminosity_t)0, (luminosity_t)1)
4942 * (luminosity_t)65535,
4943 std::clamp (d.blue, (luminosity_t)0, (luminosity_t)1)
4944 * (luminosity_t)65535);
4945 }
4946 if (!renderedt.write_row ())
4947 return false;
4948 }
4949 }
4950 {
4951 p.filename = "/tmp/unsharpened.tif";
4952 tiff_writer renderedt (p, &error);
4953 for (int y = area.y - ext; y < area.y + area.height + ext; y++)
4954 {
4955 for (int x = area.x - ext; x < area.x + area.width + ext; x++)
4956 {
4957 rgbdata d
4958 = rendered[(y - area.y + ext) * xsize + x - area.x + ext];
4959 renderedt.put_pixel (x - area.x + ext, d.red * (luminosity_t)65535,
4960 d.green * (luminosity_t)65535, d.blue * (luminosity_t)65535);
4961 }
4962 if (!renderedt.write_row ())
4963 return false;
4964 }
4965 }
4966 {
4967 p.filename = "/tmp/collection.tif";
4968 tiff_writer renderedu (p, &error);
4969 for (int y = area.y - ext; y < area.y + area.height + ext; y++)
4970 {
4971 for (int x = area.x - ext; x < area.x + area.width + ext; x++)
4972 {
4973 point_t p
4974 = map.to_scr ({ x + (coord_t)0.5, y + (coord_t)0.5 });
4975 rgbdata m = collection_scr.noninterpolated_mult (p);
4976 renderedu.put_pixel (x - area.x + ext,
4977 std::clamp (m.red, (luminosity_t)0, (luminosity_t)1)
4978 * (luminosity_t)65535,
4979 std::clamp (m.green, (luminosity_t)0, (luminosity_t)1)
4980 * (luminosity_t)65535,
4981 std::clamp (m.blue, (luminosity_t)0, (luminosity_t)1)
4982 * (luminosity_t)65535);
4983 }
4984 if (!renderedu.write_row ())
4985 return false;
4986 }
4987 }
4988 free (buffer);
4989 }
4990
4991 /* Collect data */
4992// FIXME: prallelism here seems to cause instability (race condition)
4993#if 0
4994#pragma omp declare reduction(+ : double_rgbdata : omp_out = omp_out + omp_in)
4995#pragma omp parallel for default(none) collapse(2) \
4996 shared(area, threshold, map, scr, collection_scr,rendered2,ext,xsize) \
4997 reduction(+ : wr, wg, wb, red, green, blue)
4998#endif
4999 for (int y = area.y; y < area.y + area.height; y++)
5000 for (int x = area.x; x < area.x + area.width; x++)
5001 {
5002 point_t p = map.to_scr ({ x + (coord_t)0.5, y + (coord_t)0.5 });
5003 rgbdata m = collection_scr.noninterpolated_mult (p);
5004 rgbdata am = rendered2[(y - area.y + ext) * xsize + x - area.x + ext];
5005 if (m.red > threshold)
5006 {
5007 luminosity_t val = m.red - threshold;
5008 wr += val;
5009 red += am * val;
5010 }
5011 if (m.green > threshold)
5012 {
5013 luminosity_t val = m.green - threshold;
5014 wg += val;
5015 green += am * val;
5016 }
5017 if (m.blue > threshold)
5018 {
5019 luminosity_t val = m.blue - threshold;
5020 wb += val;
5021 blue += am * val;
5022 }
5023 }
5024 }
5025 if (!(wr > 0 && wg > 0 && wb > 0))
5026 {
5027 *ret_red = { 1, 0, 0 };
5028 *ret_green = { 0, 1, 0 };
5029 *ret_blue = { 0, 0, 1 };
5030 return false;
5031 }
5032 //printf ("Color loss info %f %f %f\n", wr, wg, wb);
5033 red /= wr;
5034 green /= wg;
5035 blue /= wb;
5036#if 0
5037 *ret_red = red;
5038 *ret_green = green;
5039 *ret_blue = blue;
5040#else
5041 *ret_red = (rgbdata){ (luminosity_t)red.red, (luminosity_t)red.green,
5042 (luminosity_t)red.blue };
5043 *ret_green = (rgbdata){ (luminosity_t)green.red, (luminosity_t)green.green,
5044 (luminosity_t)green.blue };
5045 *ret_blue = (rgbdata){ (luminosity_t)blue.red, (luminosity_t)blue.green,
5046 (luminosity_t)blue.blue };
5047#endif
5048#if 0
5049 printf ("Color loss info %i %i %i %i %f\n", area.x, area.y, area.width, area.height, map.pixel_size (area.x,area.y));
5050 ret_red->print (stdout);
5051 ret_green->print (stdout);
5052 ret_blue->print (stdout);
5053#endif
5054 return true;
5055}
5056
5057/* Render simulated screen pattern to IMG using parameters PARAM, RPARAM and
5058 DPARAM. The image is rendered in resolution WIDTH x HEIGHT. */
5059
5060bool
5061render_screen (image_data &img, const scr_to_img_parameters &param,
5062 const render_parameters &rparam, const scr_detect_parameters &dparam,
5063 int width, int height)
5064{
5065 scr_to_img map;
5066 if (!img.set_dimensions (width, height, true, false))
5067 return false;
5068 if (!map.set_parameters (param, img))
5069 return false;
5070 coord_t pixel_size = map.pixel_size ({0, 0, width, height});
5071 sharpen_parameters sharpen = rparam.sharpen;
5072 sharpen.usm_radius = rparam.screen_blur_radius * pixel_size;
5073 sharpen.scanner_mtf_scale *= pixel_size;
5074 std::shared_ptr<screen> scr = render_to_scr::get_screen (
5075 param.type, false, false, sharpen, rparam.red_strip_width,
5076 rparam.green_strip_width);
5077 for (int y = 0; y < height; y++)
5078 for (int x = 0; x < width; x++)
5079 {
5080 const int steps = 4;
5081 rgbdata d = { 0, 0, 0 };
5082 for (int xx = 0; xx < steps; xx++)
5083 for (int yy = 0; yy < steps; yy++)
5084 d += scr->interpolated_mult (
5085 map.to_scr ({ x + (xx + 1) / (coord_t)(steps + 1),
5086 y + (yy + 1) / (coord_t)(steps + 1) }));
5087 d *= (coord_t)1 / (coord_t)(steps * steps);
5088 img.put_rgb_pixel (x, y, {
5089 (unsigned short)(invert_gamma (d.red, rparam.gamma) * 65535),
5090 (unsigned short)(invert_gamma (d.green, rparam.gamma) * 65535),
5091 (unsigned short)(invert_gamma (d.blue, rparam.gamma) * 65535)
5092 });
5093 }
5094 return true;
5095}
5096
5097static bool
5098similar_solution_p (finetune_result &res1, int type, finetune_result &res2, int type2)
5099{
5100 if (type != type2)
5101 return false;
5102 return res1.coordinate1.dist_from (res2.coordinate1) < 1
5103 && res1.coordinate2.dist_from (res2.coordinate2) < 1;
5104}
5105
5106/* Try to brute-force finetuning and detect screen coordinates. */
5107
5108bool
5109autodetect_coordinates (const image_data &img, scr_to_img_parameters &param,
5110 const render_parameters &rparam,
5111 progress_info *progress)
5112{
5113 int steps = 11;
5114 finetune_parameters fparams;
5115 /* What screens are autodetected well.
5116 TODO: For improved dioptichrome we need to add support for angle between
5117 elements; Normal dioptichrome will be misdetected as Dufay since geometry
5118 is same, but colors are different. Similarly for Joly/Warner-Powrie etc.
5119 We may want to add combined screen types and let user to choose in GUI. */
5120 constexpr scr_type supported_screns[] = { Paget, Dufay, Joly };
5121 constexpr int n_supported_types
5122 = sizeof (supported_screns) / sizeof (scr_type);
5123 int screens = 1;
5124 if (param.type == Random)
5125 screens = n_supported_types;
5126 std::vector<finetune_result> res (steps * steps * screens);
5127 fparams.flags = colorscreen::finetune_position
5128 | colorscreen::finetune_guess_coordinates
5129 | colorscreen::finetune_bw /*| finetune_screen_blur*/;
5130 if (progress)
5131 progress->set_task ("autodetecting coordinates in multiple samples",
5132 steps * steps * screens);
5133 for (int y = 0; y < steps; y++)
5134 for (int x = 0; x < steps; x++)
5135 for (int scr = 0; scr < screens; scr++)
5136 if (!progress || !progress->cancel_requested ())
5137 {
5138 scr_to_img_parameters p;
5139 if (param.type == Random)
5140 p.type = supported_screns[scr];
5141 else
5142 p.type = param.type;
5143 int_image_area area
5144 = rparam.get_image_area (img.width, img.height);
5145 p.center = { area.x + (0.5 + x) * area.width / steps,
5146 area.y + (0.5 + y) * area.height / steps };
5147 {
5148 sub_task task (progress);
5149 res[y * steps * screens + x * screens + scr]
5150 = finetune (rparam, p, img, {}, nullptr, fparams, progress);
5151 }
5152 if (progress)
5153 progress->inc_progress ();
5154 }
5155
5156 int best_i = -1;
5157 int best_n = 0;
5158 double best_sum = 0;
5159
5160 for (int i = 0; i < (int)res.size (); i++)
5161 if (res[i].success && res[i].contrast > 1/1280.0)
5162 {
5163 int n = 0;
5164 double sum = 0;
5165 double unc = 0;
5166 int bi = -1;
5167 for (int j = 0; j < (int)res.size (); j++)
5168 if (res[j].success && res[j].contrast > 1/1280.0
5169 && similar_solution_p (res[i], screens > 1 ? i % screens : 1,
5170 res[j], screens > 1 ? j % screens : 1))
5171 {
5172 n++;
5173 sum += 1/res[j].uncertainty;
5174 if (bi == -1 || unc > res[j].uncertainty)
5175 {
5176 bi = j;
5177 unc = res[j].uncertainty;
5178 }
5179 }
5180 if (best_i == -1 || best_sum < sum)
5181 {
5182 best_i = bi;
5183 best_sum = sum;
5184 best_n = n;
5185 }
5186 }
5187#if 0
5188 struct group {
5189 scr_type type;
5190 point_t c1, c2;
5191 double weight;
5192 int best_index;
5193 luminosity_t best_u;
5194 };
5195 std::vector<group> groups;
5196 for (int i = 0; i < (int)res.size (); i++)
5197 if (res[i].success)
5198 {
5199 scr_type type = (param.type == Random) ? supported_screns[i % screens] : param.type;
5200 int found = -1;
5201 for (int g = 0; g < (int)groups.size (); g++)
5202 if (groups[g].type == type
5203 && res[i].coordinate1.dist_from (groups[g].c1) < 0.1
5204 && res[i].coordinate2.dist_from (groups[g].c2) < 0.1)
5205 {
5206 found = g;
5207 break;
5208 }
5209 if (found != -1)
5210 {
5211 groups[found].weight += 1.0 / std::max ((coord_t)1e-6, (coord_t)res[i].uncertainty);
5212 if (res[i].uncertainty < groups[found].best_u)
5213 {
5214 groups[found].best_u = res[i].uncertainty;
5215 groups[found].best_index = i;
5216 }
5217 }
5218 else
5219 groups.push_back ({type, res[i].coordinate1, res[i].coordinate2,
5220 1.0 / std::max ((coord_t)1e-6, (coord_t)res[i].uncertainty), i, res[i].uncertainty});
5221 }
5222
5223 int best_g = -1;
5224 double max_w = -1;

5238 param.type = groups[best_g].type;
